## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Financial Center Road - Downtown Dubai.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> As grown-ups, we call this 'the daily grind' or 'life', but kids are fascinated by it. And if you've ever hoped your children could learn the value of working an honest day to make a buck, KidZania Dubai will make your dream come true for you. Brilliantly executed, KidZania Dubai is a kid-sized minicity, complete with buildings, paved streets, vehicles, and even familiar shops and offices.
>
> Children can have fun trying the jobs they're curious about. Store clerk, mechanic, doctor, chef... there are more than 80 professions for them to try here. Once they've worked, they can spend the money they've earned and try doing the shopping or booking a flight!
>
> Meanwhile, you'll be enjoying food, drinks and free WiFi in the Adults Lounge (or spending real money in the Dubai Mall).

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €25.02. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 27 ratings and 14 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
